d:
aap sabhi ko dipavli ki hardik shubhkamnaen! shubh dipavli! jay man lakshmi!
Dipavli ke pavan parv par prastut hai man lakshmi, bhagvan shri ganesh aur man sarasvati ki bhakti se saja yah vishesh bhajan sangraha. dipavli ke din kali puja ka bhi mahatv hai sath men man sarasvati ke pujan ki bhi paranpra hai islie hamne is vishesh prastuti men sabhi bhajnon aartiyon ko samahit kiya hai
